title: AWARD OF BID NO. F-1287 TO PAMCO MACHINE WORKS, INC. FOR BADGER AVENUE BRIDGE GEAR BOX INSPECTION AND RESEALING SERVICES
text:
RESOLUTION NO. ____________ - AWARD OF BID NO. F-1287 TO PAMCO MACHINE WORKS, INC. FOR BADGER AVENUE BRIDGE GEAR BOX INSPECTION AND RESEALING SERVICES
Transmittal 1
Transmittal 2
Summary
: Staff requests approval of Bid No. F-1287 (Contract) with Pamco Machine Works, Inc. (Pamco) in Rancho Cucamonga, California, for Badger Avenue Bridge gear box inspection and resealing services. The one-time Purchase Order will provide Badger Avenue Bridge gear box inspection and resealing services in the amount of $970,456.88, including taxes. The proposed action is aligned with the Harbor Department’s Strategic Plan, Objective 1: World Class Infrastructure that Promotes Growth. The City of Los Angeles Harbor Department (Harbor Department) will be financially responsible for the payment of expenses incurred under the proposed Contract.
Recommendation
: Board resolve to 1) find that the Director of Environmental Management has determined that the proposed action is administratively and categorically exempt from the requirements of the California Environmental Quality Act (CEQA) under Article II, Section 2(f) and Article III, Classes 1(1) and 1(4) of the Los Angeles City CEQA Guidelines; 2) approve Bid No. F-1287 with Pamco to inspect and reseal gear boxes at Badger Avenue Bridge in the amount of $970,456.88, including taxes, and authorize said expenditures; 3) authorize the Executive Director to execute and the Board Secretary to attest to Bid No. F-1287 for and on behalf of the Board; and 4) adopt Resolution No. _________________.
